Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax exemptions for log haulers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing excise tax exemptions for log haulers;adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.16 RCW; providing an effective date; and providingexpiration dates.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a person inrespect to the business of log hauling in the state of Washington. Toqualify for the exemption, the person's vehicle must be subject to thelicensing fee in schedule A of RCW 46.16.070 and the logs must beprocessed in the state of Washington. (2) This section expires June 30, 2010.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a person inrespect to the business of log hauling in the state of Washington. To p. 1 HB 3307qualify for the exemption, the person's vehicle must be subject to thelicensing fee in schedule A of RCW 46.16.070 and the logs must beprocessed in the state of Washington. (2) This section expires June 30, 2010.
